title: 60亿买回：只是创可贴，市场想要长期整顿？
speaker: Michael Tang

segments.en: I think it was what was a bit, I guess, disappointing for the market. Is there anything more that you think the Treasury could do to arrest this slump in any way?
segments.zh: 我认为这对市场来说有点令人失望。你认为财政部还能做些什么来遏制这种下滑吗？

segments.en: Well, I think what Treasury probably have to do is probably a more long-term sustainable fiscal consolidation plan.
segments.zh: 嗯，我认为财政部可能必须做的是制定一个更长期、可持续的财政整顿计划。

segments.en: I think a lot of this staff buybacks, a lot of this talk from Besson as well is all very band-aids and sugar hits.
segments.zh: 我认为很多这些买回操作，以及贝森的很多言论，都只是权宜之计和短期刺激。

segments.en: I think there's a pretty strong argument that a lot of this is very, very temporary.
segments.zh: 我认为有相当充分的理由认为，很多这些都是非常非常暂时的。

segments.en: I think the market was also looking maybe 10 billion, but I'm not even sure that necessarily would have done the job.
segments.zh: 我认为市场可能也在期待100亿，但我不确定那是否一定能解决问题。

segments.en: I think a big part of it was also Scott Besson was, I think, had fighting words to speak as well, saying he's the house, don't bet against him, and I think the market was essentially very ready to see how true to his word he could be.
segments.zh: 我认为很大一部分原因也是斯科特·贝森说了些强硬的话，说他是庄家，不要与他作对，我认为市场基本上非常想看看他能否兑现诺言。

segments.en: So ultimately, buybacks doesn't seem like they're going to be a good long-term solution either.
segments.zh: 所以最终，买回似乎也不会是一个好的长期解决方案。

segments.en: Michael, just on relative trades, I mean, we're seeing in the Treasury market where we saw overnight is obviously bleeding into where you are. I just had to look at the Aussie 10, the Kiwi 10, Japanese 10 as well. Any opportunities emerging within the spread space?
segments.zh: Michael，就相对交易而言，我们看到国债市场的隔夜走势显然正在蔓延到你所在的市场。我刚刚看了澳洲10年期、新西兰10年期、日本10年期。在利差空间中有任何机会出现吗？
